The document, docs/design/requirements-map.md, is otherwise solid: the requirements table covers the brief and all 11 addenda, the strategy view says how it is kept current, the roadmap gives its order and dependencies, alternatives are listed, and only docs changed. I checked the citations against the files. Almost all are real: every BRIEF.md line, including the GitHub-features permission at 129 and the upstream ban at 130, every decision-log heading, and the design-doc and README lines. O1 now cites the status line at athena-v0.md:3, not D46. The two errors are in CHANGELOG.md. This same change adds 4 lines near the top of CHANGELOG.md, but the document cites the old line numbers. So 'CHANGELOG.md:203' (the 0.1.0 section) is really line 207, and 'CHANGELOG.md:21' (the unmeasured sccache speedup) is really line 25. The retry was meant to stop exactly this kind of mistake.
